name: dunesub-integration
description: Ecosystem policy tooling and a self-contained Cloudflare SEO agent service

scripts.seo:check: npm run seo:configure && npm run check --prefix services/seo-agent
scripts.seo:build: npm run seo:configure && npm run build --prefix services/seo-agent
scripts.seo:verify: npm run seo:provenance && npm run seo:check && npm run seo:test && npm run seo:smoke
scripts.seo:dev: npm run seo:configure && npm run dev --prefix services/seo-agent
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run validate:payload && npm run security:scan
